title: Shemayah, brother of Achiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Taanit 18b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.18b.5) describes two brothers, Shemayah and Achiya. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Taanit.18b.5.1) says they were pious men without identifying them. [Arukh, s.v. Harag](https://torahwords.org/aru_1492#a2358) identifies them as the martyrs of Lod mentioned in [Pesachim 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.50a.8)

notes.text: The Arukh explicitly names Shemayah and his brother. In [Rashi’s other gloss](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Taanit.18b.8.2) the martyrs of Lod are instead identified with Lulianus and Pappus, figures in a separate exchange in Taanit.
